messages:
Sam (product): FYI — BeaconPay flagged a 30% p95 latency increase on inference for their chat flow after Saturday's runtime push. Sales is asking for next steps and timeline.
Ivy (sales): Customer is escalated, wants SLA remediation options. They said impact hits checkout, so higher biz risk. Asking if we can fast-track a mitigation. :worried: 
Ravi (support): Observed spike in p95 and error retries correlating w/ longer sequences. I attached traces in the ticket (internal). Looks like KV cache miss rate jumped.
Priya (eng-runtime): Can you paste the trace ids? KV cache miss could be cache eviction policy or a change in seq distribution. Saturday deploy included a batching tweak.
Ravi (support): trace ids: t-1972a, t-1972b. Quick query I ran: `select p95, error_rate from inference_metrics where customer='beaconpay' and day >= '2026-03-14'` shows p95 from 210ms -> 270ms and retries +3x.
Ben (oncall): Deploy-bot shows the weekend rollout touched the batching config (continuous_batching.enabled=true) and an optimization to prefer larger batches for tokens >512.
deploy-bot: staged rollout completed 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC for service=runtime-v3.
Maya (solutions): BeaconPay is on Dedicated with reserved GPU pool. They expected stable latency. Can we route them to the older runtime variant as a short-term rollback?
Priya (eng-runtime): We have a compatible variant (runtime-v2) but routing changes touch config and may need a restart for that shard. Cold restart could take ~6-8 minutes, and we'd need to coordinate w/ infra.
Sam (product): Need a decision: 1) Emergency rollback/reroute now (customer-first, higher ops cost) 2) Implement a targeted mitigation (adjust batch thresholds for BeaconPay) 3) Triage into backlog for next sprint with postmortem. What's the minimal viable mitigation and how long?
Priya (eng-runtime): Minimal mitigation: bump per-customer max_batch_size to 1 for requests with seq>512 or force smaller batches for that customer — ~4-6 engineer-hours including tests and canary. Rolling change, no restart.
Ivy (sales): Customer will accept a temporary routing or config change if we can give them a firm ETA under 12 hours. They asked for an SLA credit but said they'd hold if we show clear action.
Ben (oncall): I can own the rollout tonight. Need a clear playbook: pre-change baseline, canary (5% of traffic), monitor p95 & retries for 15 min, then full.
Sam (product): OK treat as hotfix. Priya, is 4-6 hrs realistic to code, test, and hand to Ben to roll?
Priya (eng-runtime): Yes. I'll scope as: 2h code, 1h unit + integration test, 1h deploy ops handoff. Add 1-2h buffer.
Maya (solutions): I'll prepare customer comms: immediate mitigation plan + ETA. Also ask them to send a sample of long sequences so we can replicate locally.
Leo (pmm): Quick question — do we need to consider messaging to broader customers? If this is a perf regression risk for others, we should include messaging template.
Sam (product): Good point. Ravi, can you check top 10 customers by qps for similar seq distributions and flag any >=10% exposure?
Ravi (support): On it. Quick grep shows 3 small customers with similar patterns, none on Dedicated except BeaconPay. I'll paste list in the ticket.
Priya (eng-runtime): After hotfix, we should add regression test: synthetic workload with skewed long sequences and a gate in CI to catch batching regressions. Scope estimate: 2-3 sprint days. Recommend adding to roadmap as "batching regression test coverage".
Sam (product): Launch criteria for the hotfix: a) config change deployed to canary (5%) b) p95 reduces to <=230ms and retries return to baseline within 30 minutes c) runbook updated and customer notified. If these met, close as mitigated and schedule full fix.
Ivy (sales): I'll tell BeaconPay: we can start mitigation now, ETA 6-8 hours, will update every 2 hours. They want to be on the canary if possible.
Ben (oncall): Will run the canary and monitor. I'll post metrics every 15 min to the ticket channel.
Priya (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR for the config override with tests. Assign to Ben for rollout.
Sam (product): Prioritization note for roadmap: we accept short-term hotfix and will prioritize the CI regression in next planning cycle. Product asks eng to estimate full fix (design + tests + perf work) for capacity planning.
Maya (solutions): I'll draft the customer note and a plain-english FAQ for support.
Ravi (support): BeaconPay also asked whether fallback to a smaller model is possible. That would reduce latency but may affect quality — need product decision.
Sam (product): Not for hotfix. Post-mitigation, we'll present options: model fallback, route to dedicated padding, or billing SLA adjustments.
Leo (pmm): Recommend we log this as a "customer-impact" item in roadmap board with severity=high and owner=Sam.
Sam (product): Done — I'll create the ticket and add acceptance criteria. Thanks team. Will follow up in 2h with status.
Ivy (sales): BeaconPay acknowledges the plan and appreciates fast action. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: change-request opened: cr-6429, assigned to priya/runtime.
Priya (eng-runtime): PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2345 — will push updates shortly.
Ben (oncall): Canary started 1972001800. Monitoring now.
Ravi (support): Canary metrics: p95 -> 225ms, retries -> baseline. Posting graphs in ticket.
Sam (product): Excellent. Closing loop here once full rollout completes and postmortem is scheduled.
